title: Green-synthesized Fe–Zn bimetallic nanoparticles alleviated cadmium accumulation and enhanced plant growth in Oryza sativa L. cv. (IR64)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4700-4721
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00620A, Paper
Nilanjana Ghosh, Geetha Gopal, Abisha Christy Christudoss, Swarnali Dey, Indranil Samajpati, Dhivya Viswanathan, Surupa Paul, Subhabrata Paul, Amitava Mukherjee, Rita Kundu
Bimetallic nanoparticles (BNPs) have emerged as a sustainable alternative to monometallic nanoparticles (MNPs) for Cd amelioration and efficient nutrient delivery in rice.
